title: L3Cube-MahaHate: A Tweet-based Marathi Hate Speech Detection Dataset and BERT models
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is the detection of hate speech, an inherently ethical concern. It creates a dataset and benchmarks models on their ability to classify text into ethical categories like 'hate', 'offensive', and 'profane'. The definition of 'hate' speech in the paper explicitly includes targeting groups based on religion, thus directly involving both ethics and religion in the evaluation task.
